differences: cooltools averages a window x window block whose rows run (i-w, i] — it includes row i; this repo sums the block [i-w, i) that excludes it
cooltools drops the first ignore_diags diagonals; this repo drops none
cooltools divides by the count of valid positions, excluding bad bins; this repo sums and requires a fraction of the window to be present
cooltools normalises by the region median; this repo by the contig mean
cooltools masks positions within min_dist_bad_bin of a dropped bin
